decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.
The external finishing materials of the roof extension shall match those used in the construction of the existing building. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than six residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate surrounding

No cooking facilities, including hot plates, shall be installed in the bedrooms of the development hereby permitted unless details have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Any cooking facilities shall thereafter only be implemented in accordance with the details that have been approved pursuant to this condition.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area

Prior to occupation waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers shall be provided on site, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities are to be retained thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets

Notwithstanding drawing 25_1013_106, prior to occupation, six long stay cycle parking spaces to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers on site shall be fully provided. The dedicated cycle store providing six long stay parking spaces shall fulfil the following criteria: Location: Near entrances or main access, Design: Stands, Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit, Fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof, Accessibility: 1.2m wide, Step-free, no obstructions.Cycle parking shall be retained on site thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport

The development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the submitted Flood Risk Assessment, including all mitigation measures and recommendations contained therein. All approved mitigation measures shall be fully implemented prior to first occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.Reason:To ensure that the development is safe from flooding, does not increase flood risk elsewhere, and accords with national and local planning policy.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (as amended), no flank windows to the dormer window hereby approved shall be installed other than those expressly shown on the approved drawings, without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.Reason:To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties.
